decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.029); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.712.
